narration.id: Bismillah… yuk mulai! Hari ini kita menjenguk pohon rambutan di kampung.
narration.en: Bismillah… let's begin! Today we visit the rambutan tree in the village.

praise.en: Look, what a big rambutan tree!

narration.id: Toto, Lili, dan Nana datang berkunjung. "Assalamualaikum!" sapa mereka riang.
narration.en: Toto, Lili, and Nana come to visit. "Assalamualaikum!" they greet cheerfully.

narration.id: Wah, pohonnya tinggi sekali! Buahnya merah dipaling atas.
narration.en: Wow, the tree is so tall! The red fruit is right at the top.

praise.id: Hampir sampai! Tangan Toto belum sampai buahnya.
praise.en: Almost! Toto's arms cannot reach the fruit yet.

narration.id: Nana punya ide: "Ayo goyang pohonnya BERSAMA-SAMA!"
narration.en: Nana has an idea: "Let's shake the tree TOGETHER!"

praise.en: Shake! Shake! The fruit comes tumbling down!

narration.id: Lima rambutan jatuh. Ayo hitung bersama satu sampai lima!
narration.en: Five rambutans fell. Let's count together from one to five!

narration.id: Tuk… tuk… Momo si Siput datang terlambat. Tangannya masih kosong.
narration.en: Tap… tap… Momo the snail arrives late. His hands are still empty.

praise.id: Ayo ikut, Momo! Semua punya bagian di sini.
praise.en: Come join us, Momo! Everyone gets a share here.

narration.id: Sebelum makan, cuci tangan dulu. "Bismillah," kata mereka serempak.
narration.en: Before eating, wash your hands. "Bismillah," they say together.

praise.id: Tangan bersih, hati siap makan bersama!
praise.en: Clean hands, hearts ready to eat together!

narration.id: Semuanya makan rambutan bersama. "Alhamdulillah, buahnya manis!"
narration.en: Everyone eats rambutan together. "Alhamdulillah, the fruit is sweet!"

praise.id: Nyam nyam nyam! Manisnya terasa hati ikut senang.
praise.en: Yum yum yum! The sweetness makes hearts happy too.

narration.id: Berbagi dengan teman membuat hati riang. Alhamdulillah!
narration.en: Sharing with friends makes the heart glad. Alhamdulillah!

praise.en: See you in the next story!

prompts.id: Siapa yang kamu ajak berbagi hari ini?
prompts.en: Who will you share with today?

prompts.id: Bagaimana perasaanmu saat berbagi dengan teman?
prompts.en: How do you feel when you share with a friend?
